Thanks Jonas — putting the pieces together below (draft language we can share):

1) Logs and telemetry:
- Operational and application logs: retained for 90 days by default, stored in per-region log buckets with tenant identifiers masked for aggregated retention metrics. Access is logged and limited to SRE/infra roles.
- Audit logs (IAM/API actions) are retained for 365 days.

2) Backups/snapshots:
- Daily snapshots of model serving state and configuration are taken; full filesystem backups are weekly. Retention: 30 days for daily snapshots, 90 days for weekly full backups.
- Backups are encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS) where requested; default is service-managed KMS.
- Deletion: when an account is terminated we mark snapshots for deletion and run an irreversible purge job within 30 calendar days; retention beyond 30 days requires explicit written exception (rare).

3) Prompts and completions:
- By default, prompts and completions are transient and used for request processing only. We persist minimal request metadata for 7 days to support debugging and throttling; full-text conversational prompts are not stored unless the customer opts into logging (opt-in logging feature).
- KV cache (runtime keys) are ephemeral and destroyed when the session ends; no persistent storage of KV cache for standard deployments.

4) Sample evidence artifacts we can provide (redacted):
- Per-account deletion log stub (deletion_log_sample.csv) showing timestamps and operator id
- Backup deletion record extract (backup_policy_snippet.txt)
- SOC2-Type II report link and CAIQ/SIG summary (we can complete a SIG questionnaire on request)
- DPIA summary covering data minimization and risk mitigations

Notes / open items:
- For EU accounts under SCCs, we should propose an addendum that clarifies backup deletion timelines and KMS arrangements; Vivek, can we draft standard language for the SCC addendum?
- For accounts that require HIPAA / longer retention controls, backup retention can be extended under contract and documented in the DPA.

I attached a small excerpt of the backup policy for the artifact package. Suggest we send a consolidated package to NovaPulse by EOD 2026-07-16; if LegalOps needs expedited artifacts, we can push earlier.
